title: Unimpressive
text:
Unimpressive. This isn't anything remarkable.
It's a Low End, Fairly Weak Output Heater that has very stiff control knobs and arrived with part of the facing somewhat caved in - probably easily done since the packaging was pretty poor.
Honestly, you can get considerably better for less at any Dollar General.

On the other hand - It was delivered quickly, placed in my hand, by very polite young lady who works for Amazon delivery. Honestly the third star is just because of Amazon's great service, not the heater.
